name: Nakwon-ui Jangryesik
source:
Dojun arrives at a secluded church believing he has found salvation.

But behind Father Michael’s kindness, Jinsu’s dangerous affection, and the quiet beauty of paradise, something rotten is waiting to be uncovered.

[From [url=https://nonstopbl.itch.io/funeral-of-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
